remarks: Unique opportunity on one of the most coveted streets in the Hunt Club neighborhood. Privacy plus convenience can be enjoyed at this stone residence sited on a park like acre with an inground gunite pool & spa surrounded by walls of greenery, specimen trees and plantings. Features include a fabulous Great room with a cathedral ceiling, beams & a stone fireplace that leads to a large family room with built-ins, wet bar,  French doors and a welcoming screened porch, overlooking an expansive yard. The main floor primary suite includes an ensuite bath with spa tub, & separate shower. Overall good floor plan with 4 bedrooms, 3.5 baths, for easy expansion. Experience a dream life among multi-million $$ exquisite homes: renovate, expand, build new, at this desirable property. Located minutes to the train, beach, shops, schools, restaurants and more.
